meta.themes: light is :root in tokens.css and the theme the package ships as default; dark is the .dark class, which the consuming app applies (no prefers-color-scheme).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground; also the fill of outline buttons, dialog popups and the selected segment of a SegmentedControl.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, card and popover. Also a fill: the solid button, a checked checkbox and the tooltip.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surface for app cards. No library component fills with it.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: PopoverContent, SelectContent, the CommandPalette window.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one hue: link buttons, the CommandPalette prefix, the focus color via ring. Punctuation, not a large fill.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a primary fill. In dark it is 3.61:1 on primary: keep such text at 24px+ or bold 18.66px+.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Track of the SegmentedControl and the CommandPalette key hints.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover and open fill of outline and ghost buttons; Kbd fill; DialogFooter at 50%.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: placeholders, descriptions, inactive tabs and nav items, plain buttons. Dark: 4.10:1 on background, 3.81:1 on popover (under 4.5:1, as the source ships it).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlighted row: ListItem highlighted, focused SelectItem, selected BottomNavigation item. At 50% it is the hover fill of rows and ghost fields.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Invalid borders and rings, the hover of destructive and plain buttons. Same hue as primary.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: panels, chips, keycaps, outline buttons, tab rails, separators. 1.21:1 (light) and 1.38:1 (dark) on background: a divider, not the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of Input, Textarea, Select trigger and Checkbox; in dark also their fill at 30%. Under 3:1 on background, as the source ships it.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus: the border of a focused field and the ring drawn at 50% around it.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar ground. Exposed for consumers; no library component uses it.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active marker in an app sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered or active sidebar row.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Hairline beside an app sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside an app sidebar.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasized 1px line: the default button, strong chips, the focus underline of ghost fields, secondary button hover.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of the default button.

tokens.name: muted-foreground-strong
tokens.usage: Brighter secondary text: secondary and destructive button labels, Kbd text.

tokens.name: muted-foreground-faint
tokens.usage: Dim labels: faint chips, CommandPalette group and section titles and messages. Dark: 2.56:1 on background, 2.38:1 on popover; labels only.

tokens.name: muted-foreground-ghost
tokens.usage: Dimmest tier: the CommandPalette footer hint words. 2.46:1 (light), 1.76:1 on popover (dark): decorative.

tokens.name: tint-red
tokens.usage: Tinted background paired with tint-red-foreground (label colors). Source: color-mix of #ff5370 22% over #fafafa (light), #f07178 12% over #0a0a0a (dark).

tokens.name: tint-red-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on tint-red (4.97:1 light, 6.07:1 dark).

tokens.name: tint-orange
tokens.usage: Tinted background. Source: #f76d47 22% over #fafafa; #f78c6c 12% over #0a0a0a.

tokens.name: tint-orange-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on tint-orange (5.00:1, 7.19:1).

tokens.name: tint-yellow
tokens.usage: Tinted background. Source: #ffb62c 22% over #fafafa; #ffcb6b 12% over #0a0a0a.

tokens.name: tint-yellow-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on tint-yellow (5.26:1, 10.65:1).

tokens.name: tint-green
tokens.usage: Tinted background. Source: #91b859 22% over #fafafa; #c3e88d 12% over #0a0a0a.

tokens.name: tint-green-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on tint-green (4.58:1, 11.37:1).

tokens.name: tint-cyan
tokens.usage: Tinted background. Source: #39adb5 22% over #fafafa; #89ddff 12% over #0a0a0a.

tokens.name: tint-cyan-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on tint-cyan (4.54:1, 10.56:1).

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: Tinted background. Source: #6182b8 22% over #fafafa; #82aaff 12% over #0a0a0a.

tokens.name: tint-blue-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on tint-blue (4.69:1, 7.35:1).

tokens.name: tint-magenta
tokens.usage: Tinted background. Source: #7c4dff 22% over #fafafa; #c792ea 12% over #0a0a0a.

tokens.name: tint-magenta-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on tint-magenta (5.01:1, 7.04:1).

families.sans: 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Hiragino Sans', Meiryo, sans-serif

styles.name: text-2xs
styles.usage: The library's own size step (--text-2xs 0.625rem / 0.875rem): Chip, Kbd, CommandPalette group titles, key hints and footer.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button sizes default and lg; the solid variant sets 700.

styles.name: palette-prefix
styles.usage: The CommandPalette prefix glyph, in primary.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: ListItem, SelectItem, Select trigger, DialogContent and DialogDescription; Input and Textarea from md (768px).

styles.name: text-base
styles.usage: Input and Textarea below md, so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus.

styles.name: nav-label
styles.usage: BottomNavigation item labels (text-[11px] leading-none), single line.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: --font-code: code samples in consuming apps. No library component uses it.

spacing.note: tokens.css declares no spacing; components use Tailwind's 4px step (--spacing: 0.25rem). These are the steps the components use.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: SegmentedControl track padding, md Chip vertical padding, key hint vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: sm Chip and Kbd horizontal padding, gaps inside xs/sm buttons and chips, TabsList gap, BottomNavigation icon-label gap, ghost-field inline padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Default button gap, md Chip horizontal padding, tab and FieldTrigger vertical padding, SelectItem start padding, Panel sm vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: ListItem gap, xs button padding, BottomNavigation item padding, CommandPalette header gap, dialog close offset.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons, Input, Textarea, Select trigger and segments.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: ListItem and tab horizontal padding, Panel md padding, tooltip horizontal padding, CommandPalette header padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: DialogContent padding and gap, CommandPalette rows and header padding from md.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: DialogHeaderBar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: SelectItem end padding (room for the check); CommandPalette message vertical padding.

size.note: Component dimensions from the Tailwind classes; --dialog-inset and --tooltip-arrow-offset are declared in tokens.css.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Button xs and icon-xs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Button sm and icon-sm, Select trigger sm.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default Button, Input, Select trigger, FieldTrigger minimum height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Button lg and icon-lg; ListItem minimum height; CommandPalette footer minimum height.

tokens.name: tap-coarse
tokens.usage: ListItem minimum height on coarse pointers; CommandPalette key hint minimum width.

tokens.name: nav-item
tokens.usage: BottomNavigation item minimum width and height.

tokens.name: palette-header
tokens.usage: CommandPalette input row height.

tokens.name: dialog-header-bar
tokens.usage: DialogHeaderBar height.

tokens.name: dialog-max-width
tokens.usage: DialogContent width from sm (640px).

tokens.name: dialog-inset
tokens.usage: DialogContent maximum width below sm.

tokens.name: palette-max-width
tokens.usage: CommandPalette window width from md.

tokens.name: palette-max-height
tokens.usage: CommandPalette window height cap from md.

tokens.name: tooltip-max-width
tokens.usage: TooltipContent maximum width.

tokens.name: select-content-min-width
tokens.usage: SelectContent is at least this wide, or the trigger's width when wider.

tokens.name: textarea-min-height
tokens.usage: Textarea minimum height.

tokens.name: tooltip-arrow-offset
tokens.usage: Vertical shift of the tooltip arrow.

radius.note: --radius is 0rem in both themes, so every radius-* step computes to 0: the library is square. keycap-radius is the one rounded corner.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base radius (0rem in tokens.css). Every step below is a multiple of it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: calc(radius * 0.6). A Kbd inside a tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: calc(radius * 0.8). PopoverContent.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: = radius. Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: calc(radius * 1.4). DialogContent and the bottom of DialogFooter.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: calc(radius * 1.8). Unused by the library.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: calc(radius * 2.2). Unused by the library.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: calc(radius * 2.6). Unused by the library.

tokens.name: btn-radius-xs
tokens.usage: min(radius-md, 10px). Button xs and icon-xs.

tokens.name: btn-radius-sm
tokens.usage: min(radius-md, 12px). Button sm and icon-sm.

tokens.name: keycap-radius
tokens.usage: Kbd and the CommandPalette key hints: the only rounded corner.

shadow.note: Only floating surfaces cast a shadow. The rings are Tailwind ring utilities, which are box-shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: PopoverContent and SelectContent.

tokens.name: ring-hairline
tokens.usage: ring-1 ring-foreground/10: the edge of DialogContent and SelectContent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: ring-3 ring-ring/50: focus-visible on buttons, tabs and segments.

tokens.name: focus-ring-field
tokens.usage: ring-1 ring-ring/50 with a ring border: focus-visible on Input, Textarea, Select trigger and Checkbox.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Every disabled control and disabled SelectItem, segment or nav action.
